//: Two places to walk about in, with nothing to do there: the test town with its doors open and the lane in the country with its doors shut. Each is a game scenario (13 §3) with one world, one place and a ready-made character; the player may make their own on the creation screen. `cell` is `[x, y]`, the highest cell of that column a walker can stand in, or `[x, y, z]`, exactly that cell.
name: The town
doc: A grid of streets. Every door stands open.

name: The lane
doc: Houses between fields. Their doors are shut.

//: The test town with its doors open, so that it can be walked through before anything can open a door.
